deployment_logic.ac_off: Return 0 kW without calling the model.
deployment_logic.ac_on: Predict power using the XGBoost model.

notes: Current, voltage and Power_Factor were used only to derive ground-truth power during preprocessing.
Electrical measurements are not required by the deployed EcoTrack prediction model.
AC ON/OFF should come from the EcoTrack IR state.
Set temperature is not included because the current SplitSmart dataset does not provide reliable setpoint information.
